verdict.rationale: Zero documents an official MCP server whose tools let an external agent read email (threads by ID, folder listing, search), triage it (labels, read/unread, bulk archive and delete), draft, and send (create drafts, send drafts, create and send). The connection is the weak point: the only working method is copying a browser session cookie into the Authorization header, and OAuth is marked 'coming soon'. missing for 10: a production-grade documented auth method (OAuth), any evidence of connecting with named agents such as Claude or ChatGPT, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an external agent — Claude, ChatGPT, or my own — can read, triage, draft, and send my email end to end through a documented connection

citations.quote:
Get email threads by ID
- List emails in specific folders
Search emails with custom queries - Filter emails by labels

Mark emails as read/unread
- Modify email labels
Bulk delete emails - Bulk archive emails

Create and send new emails
- Create email drafts
- Send existing drafts
You can connecto ZeroMCP using two methods: 1. Better Auth session token 2. OAuth (Coming soon)
Copy the session cookie from your browser cookies and place it into the Authorization header.
